Title: Classification of Trash for Recyclability Status
Core_Methodology: SVM with SIFT features vs. standard CNN baseline
Relevance_To_Our_Project: Introduced the TrashNet benchmark dataset utilized in our research
Identified_Limitation: Did not evaluate modern lightweight transfer learning or calibrated abstention

Title: MobileNetV2: Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks
Core_Methodology: Inverted residual blocks with linear bottleneck layers and depthwise convolutions
Relevance_To_Our_Project: Forms the deep learning backbone in our transfer learning pipeline

Title: Histograms of Oriented Gradients for Human Detection
Core_Methodology: Grid-based gradient magnitude and orientation histogramming with block L2-norm
Relevance_To_Our_Project: Forms the shape and contour component (1568 dims) of our AML baseline
Identified_Limitation: Fragile to non-rigid deformations (e.g. crushed cans, crumpled bottles)

Title: Multiresolution Gray-Scale and Rotation Invariant Texture Classification with Local Binary Patterns
Core_Methodology: Circular neighborhood difference thresholding with uniform pattern categorization
Relevance_To_Our_Project: Forms the micro-surface texture component (18 dims) of our AML baseline
Identified_Limitation: Sensitive to specular reflections and lighting glares on glass and plastic

Title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
Core_Methodology: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Temperature Scaling analysis
Reported_Performance: Demonstrated modern deep networks are overconfident despite higher accuracy
Relevance_To_Our_Project: Provides the mathematical formulation for our ECE reliability diagrams
Identified_Limitation: Focused on post-hoc temperature scaling rather than selective abstention

Title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks (SelectiveNet)
Core_Methodology: Chow's optimal stopping rule applied to deep networks with a rejection head
Relevance_To_Our_Project: Direct conceptual foundation for our risk-sensitive abstention filter (tau=0.60)
Identified_Limitation: Required specialized architectural modification rather than post-calibrated thresholding

Title: Waste Categorization Using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks and Transfer Learning
Core_Methodology: ResNet-50 and DenseNet-121 fine-tuning on domestic municipal waste
Relevance_To_Our_Project: Validates transfer learning superiority over classical vision for waste sorting
Identified_Limitation: Relied on heavy compute-intensive backbones impractical for edge IoT bins

Title: Intelligent Waste Classification System Using ResNet-50 and Machine Learning
Core_Methodology: ResNet-50 feature extraction followed by 50-tree Random Forest
Relevance_To_Our_Project: Hybrid CNN-feature extractor + classical ML classifier comparison
Identified_Limitation: High inference latency; lacked uncertainty quantification for contaminated materials
